fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm or sliding gate observed at the truck-yard entrance; the building sits in an open multi-tenant Gresham/Portland industrial park and the access driveway from NE San Rafael St area is uncontrolled. Some perimeter fencing exists but no checkpoint structure.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth observed at any entrance.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Docks on the south face of the building; door count estimated from overhead imagery and fleet position (~22), partly obscured by box trucks.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Yard south of the building is full of PFG white reefer box trucks (the outbound foodservice fleet) parked in fanned rows.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located within the Portland metro industrial fabric (Gresham/NE Portland), surrounded by dense warehousing.
